subject: Remove readability refactor for failover auth to fix clang warning (#1481)
reason: The diff only inlines the trivial static helper getMessageFromSendBlock (which returns &msgblock->data[0].msg) back into clusterRequestFailoverAuth as a direct msgblock->data[0].msg.mflags[0] access, to fix a clang warning. The two expressions access the identical union member, so the FORCEACK bit is set on exactly the same byte and the failover-auth message on the wire is unchanged. This is a build-warning refactor with no behaviour change, so no scenario is needed.
